statement: The review template is worker-agnostic: with one member's Worker held fixed (an Antigravity CLI Worker), a Codex CLI Worker in the other member's seat is non-inferior to a ChatGPT website Worker on correctly identified actionable defects per cost, with blocking-defect recall at or above the floor and no guardrail inferior beyond its margin.

target.version: the built-in template of the workflow package the experiment pins

mechanism.text: The template's guarantees (independent proposals, sealed ballots, quote checks against the bytes shown, the blocking-finding rule) are code, so the outcome should not depend on the Worker source a member runs on.

intervention.text: One member's Worker swapped by configuration only: the ChatGPT website Worker replaced by a Codex CLI Worker; the other member, an Antigravity CLI Worker, unchanged.

context.text: Exact-subject reviews of pinned commits of system's own public repository, each focused on one source file the members read only as the engine shows it, offline, with no web search.
